items.statement: Manufacture every drug, prescription or over-the-counter, in compliance with current good manufacturing practice requirements.
items.quote: All drugs must be manufactured in accordance with the current good manufacturing practice regulations

items.statement: Keep records relating to prescription drugs readily available for review by FDA during inspection.
items.quote: Records relating to prescription drugs must be readily available for review

items.statement: Use only colors approved for their intended use, and declare the required statements about them on the drug label.
items.quote: Determine if the color is approved for its intended use, and required statements are declared on the drug label.

items.statement: Process powders and granulations according to the firm's own specifications.
items.quote: determine whether powders or granulations are processed according to the firm's specifications.

items.statement: Have HEPA filters in sterile drug operations certified and/or DOP tested, at a defined testing frequency.
items.quote: Review the firm's system for HEPA filters, determine if they are certified and/or Dioctyl Phthalate (DOP) tested and frequency of testing.

items.statement: Filter compressed air used in sterile drug operations at the point of use to control particulates.
items.quote: Review the compressed air system and determine if it is filtered at the point of use to control particulates.
